section_summary.extract_value: This paper reports a single study of 253 women (aged 18–50) who completed online self-report measures investigating links between social safeness, body appreciation, inflexible eating rules, and disordered eating. Path analysis indicated social safeness indirectly affected eating psychopathology via higher body appreciation and lower inflexible eating rules. The section does not mention multiple studies or provide instrument names, BMI data, or demographic breakdowns beyond age range and sample size.
